$comment: ADR-336: AI wants, aspirations, personality, moods and routines (Task 37 slice 1). Tuning knobs only — no rules live here; life.ts reads this file. Personal wants run ONLY when a bot is otherwise idle (hired: the ADR-327 hire.idle flag; unhired: makePlan returns 'idle' and no danger is near), never displacing survival needs, job work or the saddle chain. Personality is deterministic per bot: the core traits come from the bot's identity (rollTraits, seeded per world/slot) and curiosity / rhythm / favourite food / keepsake come from fnv1a of the stable bot id, so the same bot is the same person across saves. Traits are the core TRAIT_KEYS (bravery, sociability, greed, industriousness, chattiness) plus curiosity, which no core trait covers. cooldownTicks is per want: how long after completing it before it may be picked again.
